theOHIOSECONDGUIDANCESURFACE_THISLANESAN.theQuestion: Ohio ships two builder-produced files named participant-instructions.md. theOHIOSECONDGUIDANCESURFACE_THISLANESAN.theAnswer: YES on this family, and FEE_AND_WAIVER is scored PASS above.
theReasoning: 1. THE FAMILY'S OWN RECORD NAMES ONE INSTRUCTIONS SURFACE. product-wiring.json binding.instructions is a single path and it is the top-level participant-instructions.md. reports/rendered-artifacts.json lists PDFs and rasters and no markdown at all. The obligation asks whether the packet tells the participant what the record directs; on the file the family itself binds as its instructions, it does.

2. SILENCE IS NOT A COMPETING ANSWER. This lane read the second surface in full. It says nothing about court costs, nothing about final discharge and nothing about any waiting period; it contains no sentence a participant could read as meaning that money owed delays eligibility. The harm the record names - a participant who owes money waiting, or not filing - is not created by a document that never raises the subject. That is different in kind from a second surface that contradicted the first, which would fail.

3. THAT FILE DOES NOT PRESENT ITSELF AS THE PACKET'S COST STATEMENT. Its first line is 'This is a statutory-content draft and review artifact. It is not a statewide Ohio court form and is not filing-ready.' It has no 'What this costs' section. Its one money line sits inside a list headed 'Recorded R.C. 2953.321 packet requirements' - a list of things to confirm before release - and reads 'Confirm the current filing fee and waiver practice. The frozen design records $50, subject to a confirmed indigency exception and current local practice.'

4. AND HERE IS THE COST OF THE OPPOSITE ANSWER, WHICH IS WHY THIS ONE IS RIGHT RATHER THAN MERELY CONVENIENT. If FEE_AND_WAIVER were measured across every delivered guidance file, this family would fail on the OTHER limb as well - the $50-and-indigency limb that vf30 failed and VF53 converted - because that same second surface DELEGATES it ('Confirm the current filing fee and waiver practice') and cites no statute, which is exactly the defect vf30 found. A rule that failed the family for the court-costs omission would also mean VF53's conversion was wrong and vf30's finding was never cured. Whichever rule the factory adopts has to be applied to both limbs of the same obligation, and no lane has applied it that way. This lane will not invent a standard for one limb that it does not apply to the other.

5. FIX161 WAS ALSO RIGHT NOT TO PATCH IT. Adding only the court-costs sentence to a file that delegates the fee would have made that file inconsistent in a new way, and the content it renders comes from a memoRequirements block that holds no court-costs field, so carrying it there would have meant inventing a data field rather than rendering one.
theOHIOSECONDGUIDANCESURFACE_THISLANESAN.whatTheREALPROBLEMWITHTHATFILEIS: It is not a FEE_AND_WAIVER defect. It is that a file named participant-instructions.md, delivered inside the participant's own family directory, is written to a reviewer and not to a participant. This lane read every line of it. It calls the absence of a catalogued local form 'an explicit release blocker'; it says the recorded fee 'must be confirmed against current court practice' and that the local application 'must be obtained before release'; it attributes the $50 to 'the frozen design'; it refers to the participant in the third person ('The participant signs and dates the local application'); and it closes 'Track evidence key: `oh_marijuana_expungement`. Commercial and runtime authority remain false.' Release blockers, frozen designs, track evidence keys and commercial authority are this platform's words about its own workflow, addressed to nobody the participant is. That is the GUIDANCE_OPENING_LEAKS_INTERNAL_VOCABULARY class, and it is a design question about what that file is, not a gap to be plugged: if it is a review artifact it should not be named participant-instructions.md and should not sit in the delivered family directory; if it is participant guidance it needs the whole treatment the bound guide already has, fee answer included. None of the fifteen obligations as this factory defines them reaches it, and this lane is not going to stretch one to reach it. It should be dispatched as its own question, to the family's owner.
